name: remove-ai-watermarks
description: Identify and remove AI provenance marks from images, video, and text the user generated or edited, using the remove-ai-watermarks CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Identify and remove AI watermarks and provenance metadata
interface.longDescription: Runs the open-source remove-ai-watermarks CLI locally to identify C2PA, IPTC, EXIF and TC260 provenance, visible AI-generator labels and supported invisible watermarks, then removes them from images, video, and text the user generated or edited. It does not remove stock, agency or other third-party marks.
defaultPrompt: Check this image for AI watermarks and provenance metadata
Remove the AI metadata from my generated video without re-encoding it
Remove the visible AI label from the corner of my image
